text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 107,101 to 102,194 despite a late recovery, so I should assess total portfolio risk rather than focus on one month's bounce.","Making no trades avoided impulsive reactions, but it did not prevent losses; I should still review whether each holding and my overall allocation fit my goals.","Since past price moves do not predict future moves, I should base decisions on current investment merits—not recent trends or reluctance to admit a mistake."]}
